title: Installation Parts Kit Charge Calculation for Northgate Delivery & Installation
content:
The installation parts kit charge on a Northgate Delivery & Installation installation appointment is the service level's installation parts kit fee for each kit owed. The charge is rounded to the cent once, at the end, half up.

## The quantities

1. **Appliances installed** — the major appliance units sold on the purchase being delivered less the major appliance units returned from it.
2. **Kits standing** — the kit units the appointment's installation parts kit entries already carry, in all.
3. **Kits owed** — the appliances installed less the kits standing, never fewer than zero.
4. **Installation parts kit fee** — the service level's fee per appliance for the installation parts kit, as the level's installation figures state it.
5. **Charge** — the installation parts kit fee multiplied by the kits owed, rounded to the cent once, at the end, half up.

## Worked figures (hypothetical kit fee of $40.00)

| Appliances installed | Kits standing | Kits owed | Charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0 | 1 | $40.00 |
| 2 | 0 | 2 | $80.00 |
| 3 | 1 | 2 | $80.00 |
| 2 | 2 | 0 | Nothing owed |
